name: io.github.Khavel/proplab
title: NBA Prop Lab
description: NBA and WNBA player-prop analytics: daily board, graded track record, matchup and referee data.

environmentVariables.name: PROPLAB_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://nbaproplab.com.

environmentVariables.name: PROPLAB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer API key from nbaproplab.com → Account → API keys. Optional: the public tools — track record, daily dashboard, games, player search, system status — work without it.
